title: Scan a deliberately vulnerable synthetic file
disclosure: Recorded output of the real code run on synthetic data. Not a hosted service; not production behavior.
steps: The sample is synthetic code with an injectable SQL string, shell=True and MD5.
`pk scan` reports 2 errors and 1 warning with rule IDs and source lines.
Exit code 1 is the CI-failing result.
limitations: Single-file scan on synthetic code; not a benchmark against other scanners.
